_comment: Monitor mode: Engine Console can watch this machine (GPUs, memory, disks, containers, engines, models) and chat with or benchmark its engines, but change nothing. Paths are examples: use your own.
_engine_images: repository:* allows any tag of that repository, and a tag names whatever image was last pulled under it. Prefer exact references pinned by digest (repository@sha256:<digest>) for the images you have reviewed, and pin the same references for this machine in the console (host_image_pins). The console refers to llama.cpp by digest already.
